Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2027 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Possible exposure of PHI via temporary link - urgent

Hi Laura,

We discovered what appears to be a public S3 URL that returns a CSV with patient identifiers last night. The file name and some sample rows indicate it contains PHI from our integration with Redwood's embeddings export job (job id gw-embed-881).

Immediate asks:
- Can you confirm whether Redwood recorded any export or subprocessor activity for that job?
- Per our DPA, please confirm (i) whether this qualifies as an unauthorized disclosure, (ii) which subprocessors might have had access, and (iii) whether data transfer to any third country occurred.

We don't have full scope yet; we attached a quick screenshot and the URL (removed in this email for security). GreenWave is treating this as a potential reportable breach for regulator timelines. Please treat as high priority and advise your next steps and expected timelines for (a) initial triage, (b) scope determination, and (c) secure evidence transfer.

Thanks,
Marco Ruiz
Director, Platform Security
GreenWave Health
security@greenwavehealth.com

Marco —

Thank you for the heads up and for flagging this so quickly. I'm escalating this to our security and legal teams (cc'd) and we'll treat it as high priority. A few clarifying items that will help us triage immediately:
- The exact S3 path (or redacted URL) and timestamp seen by your team.
- Approximate number of affected records or size of the file.
- Any patient identifiers or sample rows you can share securely (please use the secure link in my follow-up email, but you can reply with minimal details here).

Preliminarily: our DPA language obligates Redwood to notify customers and cooperate when we confirm unauthorized access; typical internal SLA is to complete an initial triage within 72 hours of confirmation. That said, we understand regulator timing is often tighter for PHI — we will prioritize to provide a preliminary scope update within 48 hours when possible and an evidence handover plan immediately after triage.

Next steps I will trigger now:
- Marissa (CS) will open a customer incident ticket and coordinate logistics for a secure evidence upload.
- Rishi (Legal) will prepare the evidence transfer agreement and confirm any contractual notice requirements.
- I will ask Infra/Security to pull access logs and model-run traces for job gw-embed-881.

Can you confirm availability for a 30-minute call today or tomorrow to walk through the artifacts?

Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Laura / Marissa —

Adding a short legal checklist for this thread to ensure DPA obligations and downstream notices are handled correctly. Marco, copying GreenWave Legal so they have a record of our intended steps.

Checklist (high level):
1) Confirm unauthorized access vs. intended export. If confirmed unauthorized, Redwood's standard DPA clause requires notice to Customer within a commercially reasonable timeframe — we should aim for the 72-hour target while acknowledging Customer regulator needs.
2) Scope: identify affected data types, record counts, time window, and job IDs.
3) Subprocessors: provide explicit list of subprocessors who had access during the affected time window and whether any subprocessors transfer data outside the US.
4) Evidence transfer: request signed evidence transfer agreement prior to handing over logs/forensics — template attached.
5) Preservation: confirm both parties will preserve logs and copies relevant to the investigation (including internal access logs, audit trails, and storage lifecycle events).
6) Notification language: draft suggested notification text for mutual use (attached below).

Quote for ease of reuse (suggested Customer-facing wording):
"Redwood Inference has initiated an investigation into a potential unauthorized disclosure affecting files generated by job gw-embed-881. We are coordinating with GreenWave Health to determine scope, preserve evidence, and provide secure access to forensic artifacts. A preliminary scope update will be provided within 48 hours of initial triage."

Please review and let me know if GreenWave Legal prefers different timelines. I attached the evidence_transfer_template.docx for signature.

Rishi Malhotra
Associate General Counsel
Redwood Inference
